name: ipso
description: Deny edits that violate engineering decisions in force, check decision validity and compliance health, and propose verifiable new decisions. Requires ipso v0.4.0+ on PATH (v0.5.0+ for decisions.health and decisions.verifiability).

bundle_dir.title: Signed bundle
bundle_dir.description: An OCI layout from ipso bundle sign. Leave empty to use the local build from ipso compile.

bundle_digest.title: Bundle digest
bundle_digest.description: The sha256:<hex> digest the bundle must have. Required with a signed bundle.

bundle_key.title: Bundle public key
bundle_key.description: The P-256 public key PEM that signed the bundle. Required with a signed bundle.
